Services
Energy Trading & Risk Management
Energy Trading & Risk Management (ETRM) Solutions
End-to-End ETRM Platform Covering Front Office, Mid Office & Back Office
The global energy market is increasingly complex — with fluctuating prices, regulatory pressures, and rising operational risks. Our
Energy Trading & Risk Management (ETRM)
solution delivers an integrated platform that supports the complete trade lifecycle, from deal capture to settlement, ensuring transparency, compliance, and optimized decision-making.
Comprehensive ETRM for Modern Energy Businesses
Designed for LNG, Gas, Power, Crude, and Multi-Commodity Trading
Our ETRM system helps energy companies streamline operations across trading, logistics, risk, and compliance — ensuring your organization remains agile and competitive in a rapidly changing landscape.
Front Office • Mid Office • Back Office – Complete ETRM Solutions
Front Office – Trading & Market Operations
Our Front Office module empowers traders with real-time visibility and streamlined execution workflows.
Key Capabilities
Trade Capture & Execution
for LNG, Gas, Power, Crude, and Renewables
Real-Time Position Management
to track exposures, mark-to-market values, and trading limits
Market Analysis & Opportunity Identification
powered by integrated market data
Scheduling & Nominations
for physical commodity delivery (including LNG shipping workflows as used by MCGG & DGI)
Deal Entry, Validation & Contract Setup
directly within the ETRM platform
This aligns with the trading and logistics functionality delivered for
MC Global Gas Corporation (MCGG)
and
Diamond Gas International (DGI)
through the LNG ETRM implementation.
Key Capabilities
Market, Credit & Operational Risk Monitoring
Mark-to-Market Valuation & P&L Reporting
Scenario Analysis & Stress Testing
Hedging & Exposure Management Tools
Contract Lifecycle Management:
confirmations, amendments, allocations, novations
Regulatory & Compliance Reporting
aligned with energy market standards
Audit-Ready Controls & Governance Frameworks
(as emphasized in the CGI ETRM Capability Model)
This delivers transparent risk management and aligns with the “governance, risk, and control frameworks” described in the CGI ETRM capability document.
Mid Office – Risk, Valuation & Compliance
The Mid Office ensures that all trading activities remain within acceptable risk thresholds and regulatory frameworks.
Back Office – Settlements, Accounting & Operations Support
Our Back Office functionalities ensure trades are validated, settled, and recorded accurately.
Key Capabilities
Post-Trade Processing & Financial Settlement
Invoicing, Payments & Cashflow Tracking
Reconciliation & Dispute Resolution
Shadow Settlements & Record Keeping
Master Data & Contract Repository Management
Logistics & Shipment Coordination (especially essential for LNG cargoes)
Regulatory Audit Trails & Documentation Management
This supports physical delivery and financial settlement workflows — similar to the processes deployed for
Cameron LNG export operations
in the Publicis Sapient / MCGG / DGI project.
Why Energy Companies Choose ETRM System?
Complete Trade Lifecycle Coverage
From deal capture to settlement — across Front, Mid, and Back Office.
Built for LNG, Gas & Multi-Commodity Trading
Fully capable of supporting global LNG operations as proven in real-world deployments.
Risk & Compliance Ready
Aligns with global regulatory requirements, audit needs, and robust internal controls.
Flexible Integration
Connects with ERP, CTRM, forecasting tools, market-data providers, and logistic systems.
Scalable & Future-Ready
Supports expanding portfolios, new energy markets, and evolving compliance mandates.
Hire Our Expert ETRM Consultants
Market Cloud provide you with highly experienced ETRM professionals who help energy and commodity businesses streamline trading operations, manage risk, and ensure regulatory compliance with scalable, cost-effective solutions.
